- [x] I, the PR author, have personally reviewed every line of this PR.

# What does this PR do?

This PR lets `overlap_moe_expert_parallel_comm` (the combined-1F1B EP A2A overlap) work with two or more MTP layers. Until now it allowed at most one (`mtp_num_layers <= 1`).

**Root cause.** Each MTP depth's `mtp_post_process` appended its output, without detaching it, to `chunk_state.mtp_hidden_states`, and the last depth concatenated the list with `torch.cat`. With two or more depths, the last depth's node backward ran through the earlier depths' `mtp_post_process` graphs and freed them (`keep_graph=False`). Each earlier depth's own node backward then failed. With TE norms the error is `ctx must have .tensor_objects to restore saved tensors`; plain PyTorch reports "Trying to backward through the graph a second time".

**Fix** (`megatron/core/models/common/fine_grained_callables.py`). Each depth except the last now hands the concatenation a copy made with `node.detach(...)`. `TransformerLayerNode.backward_impl` then adds the gradient that the loss leaves on that copy back into the depth's own backward. The copy shares storage with the original. That stays safe because neither the next depth's `pre_dispatch_computation` nor `mtp_post_process` frees its input.

**Guards** (`TransformerConfig`). With `mtp_num_layers > 1` under EP overlap, the config now rejects the features the overlap schedule doesn't yet handle per depth:
- `mtp_use_repeated_layer`: the schedule plan builds one layer plan per MTP layer module, so a shared layer would run only one depth.
- `mtp_hsm`: the hidden-state mixing runs in `MultiTokenPredictionBlock.forward`, which the overlap schedule doesn't call.
- `enable_mhc_connections`: the overlap schedule feeds each depth the previous depth's contracted, normalized output instead of its multi-stream output.
- Full recompute: each MTP depth is its own recompute segment, so replaying a later depth would reuse the earlier depths' no-grad outputs and lose their loss gradients.

A negative `mtp_num_layers` is still rejected.

**Scope.** This is shared combined-1F1B code, so today it applies to GPTModel. On main, HybridModel still rejects MTP with EP overlap until #4798 lands. After that, HybridModel MTP (for example, Nemotron 3 Ultra's two MTP layers) uses this same path.

## Issue tracking

Linked issue: Related to #5854, which lists `mtp_num_layers <= 1` as a current limitation of HybridModel 1F1B overlap. Also related to #4798.

## Testing

Setup: 8× H100 on CoreWeave, container `nvcr.io/nvidia/nemo:26.08.01` (torch 2.13, TE 2.18) with `PYTHONPATH` pointing at this branch, markers `not experimental and not flaky and not flaky_in_dev`.

| Tests | Result |
|---|---|
| `tests/unit_tests/transformer/test_transformer_config.py -k ep_a2a_overlap` | 12 passed |
| `tests/unit_tests/a2a_overlap/test_schedule_chunk_1f1b.py -k "test_1f1b_schedule_model_chunk and not full_recompute"` | 108 passed, 32 of them with `mtp_layers=2` |
| `tests/unit_tests/a2a_overlap/test_schedule_layer_1f1b.py -k mtp` | 10 passed |
| The rest of `tests/unit_tests/a2a_overlap/test_schedule_chunk_1f1b.py` | 132 passed, 40 skipped (an existing skip for MTP with full recompute) |
| **Control:** the new 2-depth, 4-microbatch test with the detach fix reverted (guard change kept) | 2 failed, with `ctx must have .tensor_objects to restore saved tensors` raised from `mtp_post_process.backward` |

The 32 two-depth cases are:
- `test_1f1b_schedule_model_chunk` across 2 dispatchers (alltoall and flex-hybridep) × 5 FP8 settings (none, plus e4m3 or hybrid × tensorwise or blockwise) × 3 layer splits ([2,1], [1,2], [1,1]) = 30 cases.
- The new `test_1f1b_schedule_model_chunk_multi_mtp_multi_microbatch` with each dispatcher = 2 cases.

Not covered: Blackwell (MXFP8), the DeepEP and NCCL EP backends (not available in the container), and the full CI unit-test suite.

Linting: I ran black 26.3.0, isort 5.13.2, ruff 0.9 and pylint 3.2.6 (the pinned linting-group versions) on the changed files. I didn't run `tools/autoformat.sh` itself.

## Code provenance

No code was copied or adapted from external sources.

## Contribution process

### Pre-checks

- [x] I have added relevant unit tests
- [ ] I have added relevant functional tests
- [ ] If this PR adds or changes a GPU kernel (Triton, `jit_fuser`/`torch.compile`, CUDA extension, TE or external-library dispatch, or a scatter/index accumulation), I have added or updated its bit-exact determinism test and registered it in `tests/unit_tests/determinism/kernels/manifest.py` ([guide](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/main/docs/developer/determinism/testing.md)) (N/A: no kernel changes)
- [ ] I have added proper typing to my code [Typing guidelines](https://docs.python.org/3/library/typing.html)
- [ ] I have added relevant documentation
- [ ] I have run the [autoformatter.sh](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/main/tools/autoformat.sh) on my PR

### Code review

#### Step 2: Final Review

#### Step 3: Approved
